historical_references.reference: There is also a tradition that St. Petronia was a Roman girl martyred during the persecutions of Diocletian in the late 3rd century AD. According to legend, she was tortured and killed for refusing to sacrifice to the Roman gods. Her relics were later discovered and venerated in the town of Petroia in Calabria, Italy.
